pull.title: payments: enforce wallet source-of-funds provenance
pull.body:
## Summary

This adds first-class wallet source-of-funds accounting so doFast can distinguish spendable wallet value from value that is legally/economically eligible for cash-out.

## Financial invariants

1. `wallet.balance` must equal the sum of all funding-lot `remaining_amount` values.
2. Stripe/card value is `STRIPE_PAYMENT`: spendable inside doFast, but never withdrawable as cash.
3. Worker earnings are `EARNED_JOB`: spendable and withdrawable.
4. Pre-V49 positive balances are backfilled as `LEGACY_UNVERIFIED`: spendable, non-withdrawable, fail-closed for payout.
5. `PLATFORM_ADJUSTMENT` is spendable but non-withdrawable.
6. Payout reservation may consume only `withdrawable=true` lots.
7. Original-method Stripe refunds may consume only the exact funding lot for the original PaymentIntent.
8. Escrow/publication/expense/payout/refund/chargeback reversals restore the exact earlier funding movements instead of creating generic money.
9. Chargeback reinstatement preserves mixed-source identity when recovery previously consumed multiple funding sources.
10. Any wallet/funding coverage mismatch fails closed instead of inferring provenance from transaction history.

## Implementation

- Flyway V49 adds `wallet_funding_lots` and `wallet_funding_movements`.
- `WalletFundingSourceService` owns origin recording, debit allocation, exact-Stripe allocation, restoration and coverage checks.
- `WalletService` integrates provenance into every wallet mutation boundary.
- Payout, escrow, proposal, publication, expense, Stripe refund and chargeback flows use source-aware wallet APIs.
- Ordinary internal spending consumes non-withdrawable value before earnings when possible, preserving earned value for legitimate payout.
- Focused unit coverage verifies mixed-source allocation, withdrawable-only payout, exact-PaymentIntent refund, restoration and fail-closed coverage behavior.

## CI and operational hardening

- All legitimate smoke wallet seeds now create balance + wallet transaction + funding lot + funding movement atomically through a CI-only helper.
- Reconciliation tests keep raw SQL only where corruption is intentional and explicitly documented.
- Payout, ledger/refund/chargeback, platform-fee and publication-payment workflows explicitly trigger on V49 and the provenance seed helper.
- Runtime, payout, fee, publication, expense, cancellation, attachments, proposal funding, Stripe refund and chargeback smokes now assert funding provenance in addition to balances.

## Documentation

- adds `docs/WALLET_SOURCE_OF_FUNDS.md` as the canonical accounting/runbook document;
- updates wallet-payment documentation for non-withdrawable Stripe funding and exact-PaymentIntent refunds;
- updates payout documentation to remove the old fungible-wallet assumption and document withdrawable-only cash-out.

## Merge gate

Do not merge unless all required PR-triggered checks and push-triggered checks are green for the exact same latest head SHA. Merge method must be a merge commit.
